document_kind: Descriptive report and artifact interface snapshot; not agent instructions or executable configuration.
python: conda run -n py314 python; XeLaTeX/latexmk for PDFs
main_policy: Default refined: Q3 seven points at radius 1200m, center dispatch and unknown-channel scan; Q4 compact25 (940m/1870m rings, outer phase 15deg), guarded dispatch and useful scan. Fixed probes, bounded recovery and rectangle optical cover remain. Historical enhanced retains Q4 31-point 990m lattice, rolling order, separate dispatch and all-channel scan; it is a comparator, not relabeled refined.
denominators: Development 3100000..3100149: 150 worlds per problem, six Q3 and eleven Q4 configurations, 2550 runs. Frozen main 4100000..4100999: 1000 worlds per problem, three Q3 and four Q4 configurations, 7000 runs. Stress 4200000..4200049: three scenarios, three errors, two policies, two problems, 1800 runs. Random alternate errors 4210000..4210199: two errors, two policies, two problems, 1600 runs. Sensitivity 4300000..4300049: three scales, two problems, 300 runs. Frozen research total 10700; historical 4430/3080/2200 datasets remain separate.

assets_interface.research_metadata: report/generated/research_metadata.json exposes input_sha256 mapping archive-relative input paths to SHA-256, checked before packaging and before/after extracted replay.
assets_interface.historical_assets: Base and enhancement assets remain generated separately. geometry.pdf and q2_lens.pdf support Q1/Q2; ring_sweep evidence and historical seven-point/lattice comparisons retain their original labels and denominators.
assets_interface.metrics: Per-world T/N means, medians and p90, not pooled T divided by pooled N. Paired saving is control minus candidate; stress regressions and intervals crossing zero are reported. Development screens are not held-out evidence.
assets_interface.rendering: Booktabs table fragments are included by paper.tex; vector figures use English axes/legends. Source listings use English docstrings/comments where possible. report/research_theory.tex is an input narrative, not an additional full source listing.

support_interface: report/appendix.tex lists every runnable source including three new candidate modules, development/research/verifier/asset scripts. report/ai_usage.tex is a standalone anonymous Fandol ctex document identifying current happycode/gpt-6-astra through Oh My Pi, core AI contributions and outstanding official/manual evidence. reproduce.txt gives full ordered commands in the extracted archive root.
archive_verification: package.py --verify checks manifest/input/PDF hashes, anonymous paths, <=20MiB deliverables and abstract/body pages, extracts into a clean temporary directory, reruns complete 4430+3080+2200+2550+10700 datasets, checks exact ordered content excluding only measured wall-clock real_duration_s and its derived maximum max_real_duration_s, verifies research checks, regenerates all assets and compiles both PDFs. All behavioral and other summary fields remain compared. Reports actual dataset run counts (22960), not world counts. Command failures propagate; no subset replacement.
official_evidence: Official simulator remains deferred and has not been successfully run. Six genuine formal results, case codes, original encrypted exports and contestant manual review are outstanding. Future use requires GUI login, correct module, readiness, real team ID and a fresh private output directory. No scores, signatures, upload status, compliance completion or award prediction are inferred from synthetic evidence.
review_boundary: Independent automated review remains AI review. PDF visual review, archive replay and final research_review.json are recorded only after actual execution by the integration workflow; this descriptive file itself proves none of them.
